import json, subprocess, sys
def mk(pkts, **over):
    cfg = {"slots":1,"window":2,"idle_timeout":3,"len_quantum":16,"gap_quantum":1,
           "rate_num":1,"rate_den":1,"bucket_capacity":10,"initial_tokens":10,
           "pending_capacity":512,"lanes":1,"service":[1,1],"fallback":1,
           "time_edges":[0],"count_edges":[0],"probability":[[65536]]}
    cfg.update(over)
    mdl = {"classes":2,"embedding_dim":1,
           "length_embedding":[[i] for i in range(16)],
           "gap_embedding":[[0] for _ in range(16)],
           "kernel":1,"conv_weights":[[[1,0]]],"conv_bias":[0],"conv_shift":[0],
           "dense_weights":[[0],[1]],"dense_bias":[0,0]}
    return {"version":1,"config":cfg,"model":mdl,
            "connections":[{"id":"a","slot":0,"label":0,"split":"dev"}],"packets":pkts}

# idle boundary: idle_timeout=3
pk = [{"time":0,"connection":"a","length":15,"draw":0},
      {"time":3,"connection":"a","length":16,"draw":0},   # gap=3 -> 3>=3 => RESET
      {"time":5,"connection":"a","length":17,"draw":0}]    # gap=2 -> no reset
doc = mk(pk)
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"submission/main.py"], input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), capture_output=True)
out = json.loads(r.stdout)
for p in out["packets"]: print(p)
print()
for j in out["jobs"]: print(j)
PYEOF
